subject: design/pipeline-measurement-v2
statement: an append-only JSONL store in the **observability-logs directory** of the system footprint (its concrete path fixed by `#D-1`, `#ALT-1`), **gitignored** — per-run operational data, never committed — written **one file per run** (named by `run_id`), so parallel runs (PRD §12) never contend on a shared file and each append is collision-free (AP-23). Each line is one schema-versioned JSON run record: `schema_version`, `run_id`, `feature_id`, `phase_id`, `harness`, `spend` (per-model `{input,output,cache_creation,cache_read}` + `cost` + `reconciliation_tier` ∈ {exact, harness-precision, unavailable}), `efficiency` (the D-5 signals), `price_snapshot_version`, and `unavailable[]` markers. Additive-schema evolution only (AP-6): readers default missing fields. The store is orchestrator-agnostic and depends on nothing unmerged; when the Ledger lands it absorbs these schema-versioned records verbatim (O-1).
